about: Controls that change nothing to see when operated alone, by design. controls.mjs reports each under 'Could not tell' with its reason, so none is hidden and none counts as dead. A label matches when it starts with `control`; `backend` limits a row to webgpu or webgl2. Add a row only with the next action that shows the control working.

controls.reason: it sets how the next strike ends (held lit until Return to night); press Trigger a strike to see it
a cast selects its first contact and moves the probe there; this cast found one contact, so clicking it again keeps the probe where it is (with more contacts, choosing another moves it)
it sets how the camera moves at the next shot change (a cut instead of a glide); pick another shot to see it
the exhibit's three methods (weighted, moment, exact) are all order-independent transparency, and this control shows it: the picture stays the same when the draw order is reversed
the wall culls the statue's clusters only while the wall slider puts it in front of the statue; at the starting position it hides nothing, so the drawn count stays the same
